question: In a certain code language, 'PLANT' is written as 'OJXJO'. How will 'FORTE' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 'PLANT' is written as 'OJXJO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a1b3b66605702cd19f2ed183a04919b0835bd67bb4f4d828ecf6bad8a84b78.png] 

Similarly,

**'FORTE'** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8546d0124e0cc916271dad67a88ff5d6a48ff42e1e7bef4a9af74a6602023de0.png] 

Hence, '​FORTE' is coded as "EMOPZ".
